metadata.description: Nine synthetic records, carefully kept. Six illustrated folio studies, a keeper’s note, provenance, and a guide for the next reader. Original demonstration artwork; these are not historical manuscripts. Successive editions share one public archive address. Item notes distinguish the synthetic artwork from historical records and identify documents retained from earlier demo editions.

files.name: 01 - A study in ochre.svg
files.caption: Synthetic ochre folio study, first of six original demonstration illustrations. This is not a historical manuscript and its marks are not meaningful script.
files.source: Original Folio demonstration artwork, released under CC0. See 08 - Provenance.md in this collection.

files.name: 02 - The indigo folio.svg
files.caption: Synthetic indigo folio study, second of six original demonstration illustrations. This is not a historical manuscript and its marks are not meaningful script.
files.source: Original Folio demonstration artwork, released under CC0. See 08 - Provenance.md in this collection.

files.name: 03 - Notes from the valley.svg
files.caption: Synthetic folio study titled Notes from the valley, third of six original demonstration illustrations. Its title does not establish historical or geographic provenance.
files.source: Original Folio demonstration artwork, released under CC0. See 08 - Provenance.md in this collection.

files.name: 04 - A field of small things.svg
files.caption: Synthetic folio study titled A field of small things, fourth of six original demonstration illustrations. This is original demo artwork, not a historical manuscript.
files.source: Original Folio demonstration artwork, released under CC0. See 08 - Provenance.md in this collection.

files.name: 05 - Fragments, carefully kept.svg
files.caption: Synthetic folio study titled Fragments, carefully kept, fifth of six original demonstration illustrations. No authentic manuscript fragments or meaningful script are claimed.
files.source: Original Folio demonstration artwork, released under CC0. See 08 - Provenance.md in this collection.

files.name: 07 - Keeper’s note.txt
files.caption: Historical demo note from the second published edition. It records a publisher restart and deliberately repeats text to exercise recovery of a file larger than one Swarm chunk. Its edition statements refer to that earlier publication.
files.source: Original Folio demonstration documentation, preserved with the edition in which it was written. No historical manuscript provenance is claimed.

files.name: 08 - Provenance.md
files.caption: The provenance statement for the six synthetic illustrations. It explains that they are original demo artwork rather than historical manuscripts and releases the illustrations under CC0.
files.source: Original Folio demo provenance statement, also included at public/samples/PROVENANCE.md in the repository.

files.name: 09 - A way back to the story.txt
files.caption: Reader and recovery guide written for the third published edition. It preserves the stable archive address, independent recovery steps and renewable-storage limits. Its edition references describe that earlier publication.
files.source: Original Folio demonstration documentation, preserved with the edition in which it was written. No historical manuscript provenance is claimed.

priorAttempts.error: A newer version exists. Open the published archive and create a fresh editing draft.

notes: All edits use the existing authenticated keeper API. The nine original file payloads are unchanged.

Two earlier attempts stopped before signing: a startup feed-head mismatch and an independent gateway propagation delay. Both local and public heads were checked before controlled retries. Only one new feed index was appended.
No batch purchase, renewal, funding or withdrawal was performed. Bee ran only for publication and was stopped before public recovery.
The local Next.js UI was still running during this programmatic recovery, but the recovery library imports no publisher or local catalogue and requests only the public Swarm gateway.
